confidence_notes: FX comes from an RBA search result: the 18 Nov 2026 observation, AUD/USD 0.6720. I ran two searches in total, one for FX and one for Muscat prices. The price sources were crowd-sourced cost-of-living listings that disagreed widely, so the food and drink figures are bounded estimates. Beer is mostly sold in hotel bars and is heavily taxed, so it is uncertain. Search results gave $13 for a pint and $13–18 in hotels, but I set beer lower, assuming a typical serving in a licensed venue. I did not search cocktail or wine prices. I set cocktail and wine from the typical hotel-bar relationship to beer, with both priced above beer. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from live listings. Hostels are scarce in Muscat, so the hostel figures are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other Gulf cities (Dubai, Doha, Manama) but lower on restaurant prices. Alcohol is limited to licensed hotels and bars, which keeps drink prices high.
